newsitem.title: KENYA: Stocks ease in dull trading at Nairobi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Stocks ease in dull trading at Nairobi bourse.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index fell in dull trading on Monday, unsettled by a downward spiral in prices for most stocks, brokers said.
The index fell 16.29 points to stand at 3053.00. Turnover was posted at 6.831 million shillings on 158,632 shares from 13.014 million shillings on 524,285 shares on Friday.
A broker said the index was usually slow at this time of year as there were no announcements untill September when annual results come out.
The broker said investors seemd to be putting their money into other lucrative options such as government treasury bills or commercial paper.
"Being a Monday, the market saw little activity as only a few people were trading," a bourse official said.
Brokers said there were no big lots dealt from the special board or the general trading floor to boost the turnover.
Kenya Airways stock continued to stabilize on good general demand for shares but the supply situation was tight.
Kenya Airways traded 29,961 shares at 10.10 unchanged from Friday, Marshalls East Africa Ltd rose to 47 from 46.50 while Uchumi Supermarket eased to 39.25 from 40.
Among plantations, Brooke Bond rose to 177 but corrected to 176 from 175, Sasini Tea & Coffee fell to 50.50 from 53 while Rea Vipingo was unchanged at 11.30.

Barclays Bank rose to 116, dipped to 110 but marginally recovered to 112, Housing Finance Company fell to 24.25 from 26 and National Bank of Kenya traded 37,200 shares at 17.50, 17.00 and 17.10 from 17.15.
Kenya Power & Lighting Company rose to 106 from 105. Officials said foreign investors dealt 1,542 shares of Unga Group Ltd at 154 and 3,600 shares of Diamond Trust at 35 and 35.50.
